baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causal chain zayyana lahum a'malahum fa-saddahum 'an al-sabil ends with kaanu mustabsirin.
baseline_models.mechanism: An attractive evaluation is laid over intentional deeds, so agency is redirected from a traversable course even though inward discernment remains available. The failure is therefore between seeing and valuing or following, not simply an absence of information.

activation_trace.role: Making a thing appear good supplies the evaluative overlay that changes how the deeds are received.
Purposive action makes the object of adornment an enacted practice rather than a merely imagined idea.
Turning and diverting supplies the directional consequence of the attractive evaluation.
An extended route makes the loss practical and directional: a course is not being traveled.
Insight of the heart keeps cognitive penetration live while conduct goes elsewhere.

changed_reading.before: They were kept from the right way because Satan made them unable to see it.
changed_reading.after: They could discern, but attractive valuation captured the passage from discernment to purposive movement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Tabayyana lakum min masakinihim makes the dwellings a source of clarity for the later addressees, while the former inhabitants are called mustabsirin.
baseline_models.mechanism: Habitation outlasts inhabitants. Once resident motion has ceased, the settled site becomes a visible evidentiary surface; the later viewer's clarity is set against the earlier residents' unused sight.

activation_trace.role: Emergence into visibility makes the ruin-derived conclusion an uncovering rather than a bare assertion.
The inhabited home supplies the durable material locus from which the absent community is inferred.
Cessation of movement gives the inhabited place a second, terminal stillness after destruction.
Ordinary seeing mirrors the later audience's access to material remains and sharpens the irony of prior sight.

changed_reading.before: Their houses merely identify where the destroyed peoples once lived.
changed_reading.after: The emptied habitat is itself a witness whose visible stillness indicts residents who once possessed sight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Masakin, zayyana, a'mal, the named shaytan, and saddahum form a possible habitat-to-obstruction chain.
baseline_models.mechanism: Comfort, provision, repeated work, and embellishment can make a settled order self-securing. On the focus branches, the tempter's long tether and the blocking barrier allow a spatial model in which people are held by the attractive world they maintain rather than pushed off course by a single external blow.

activation_trace.role: A place or object of repose supplies the affective attachment that makes settlement hard to leave.
Sustenance that fixes residence makes material maintenance part of the tethering mechanism.
Adorning material supplies the attractive finish on the settled order.
A long, tightly worked tether supplies an exploratory image for control exercised at a distance.
A massive barrier turns accumulated attachment into an impediment on the route.

changed_reading.before: Satan stands outside the community and blocks an otherwise open road.
changed_reading.after: The community's attractive, provisioned habitat can function as the tether and barrier through which misdirection works.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier pairing of beginning with return, followed by commands to travel and inspect the earth, converts the named ruins into field evidence for a temporal claim. The proper name 'Ad acquires a restrained root-echo of return: a past civilization's end trains perception toward re-creation rather than closing history in the past.

activation_trace.role: The proper-name branch keeps the immediate referent firmly the people of 'Ad.
Return after departure supplies the temporal recurrence that can resonate with the later proper name.
Beginning coupled with repetition makes first creation and return a single temporal mechanism.
Movement through the land turns historical reflection into embodied fieldwork.
Directed visual or inward inspection supplies the operation by which remains yield inference.

structural_cues: 29:19 explicitly sequences first production and return.
29:20 orders travel, looking, and reflection on beginning before the historical ruin sequence reaches 29:38.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the root echo, the beginning-return pair, and terrestrial inspection; I infer that the proper name can act as a sound hinge from ruins to re-creation. The live alternative is that 'Ad remains semantically only a name and the echo is merely mnemonic.

changed_reading.before: The verse points backward to two finished historical disasters.
changed_reading.after: The visible end of 'Ad and Thamud also functions as field evidence for the larger beginning-and-return pattern.

context_deltas.mechanism: The path is socially marketed and socially policed. One group recruits followers to 'our way' with a false promise to transfer liability; another community turns its public gathering into a site of wrongdoing while cutting the route. Satanic adornment can therefore operate through persuasive peers, burden fictions, and communal control of access.

activation_trace.role: Diversion in the focus supplies the effect that the two social scenes help to mediate.
Following behind another supplies the recruitment relation through which a rival route gains travelers.
The explicitly possessed route makes misdirection a social offer of an alternative itinerary.
Bearing responsibility supplies the promised transfer of moral cost that makes following attractive.
Waylaying and forcibly blocking a road turns moral obstruction into a public access practice.
The assembled club supplies the institution in which deviance is normalized and displayed.
The repeated traversable route binds literal access-cutting to the focus's barred way.

structural_cues: The possessive 'our way' in 29:12, the cutting of 'the way' in 29:29, and diversion from 'the way' in 29:38 form a repeated social-spatial sequence.
29:12 pairs recruitment with a liability promise; 29:13 immediately denies cost-free transfer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two distinct path scenes, a burden promise, and a public gathering; I infer a shared mechanism in which human networks carry the focus's adornment and obstruction. They may alternatively remain separate examples with no single institutional mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes an inward, individual temptation that privately diverts each person.
changed_reading.after: Attractive wrongdoing becomes a social route-system: it recruits, reallocates apparent risk, and controls public passage.

context_deltas.mechanism: A deliberately remaining trace becomes a visible sign, and the immediately preceding bodies are described as fixed to the ground in their home. This turns the focus dwellings into negative architecture: absence, stillness, and residue disclose what the former built environment can no longer conceal.

activation_trace.role: An effect left behind supplies the persistence by which a destroyed event remains readable.
A manifest marker turns material residue into evidence rather than debris alone.
Visibility and disclosure make the sign explicitly legible.
A faculty that restrains ignorance supplies the inferential uptake required of the viewer.
Lying fixed against the earth gives the neighboring domestic scene its terminal immobility.
Loss of movement lets the focus dwellings carry the stillness produced by the preceding destruction.

structural_cues: 29:35 names a left, clear sign; 29:37 ends with motionless bodies in their home; 29:38 says clarity comes from dwellings.
The audience shift from destroyed residents to 'you' makes later inference part of the sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the remaining sign, ground-bound stillness, and clarity from dwellings; I infer that architectural residue itself testifies. A live alternative is that 'from their dwellings' means known location or report rather than direct visual archaeology.

changed_reading.before: Ruined locations merely corroborate a narrated punishment.
changed_reading.after: The inhabited world becomes a residual sign: its emptied stillness actively produces the later audience's clarity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear signs can be present, correct propositions can be spoken, and denial can still occur with knowledge. Pride magnifies the self while inversion turns it away, so mustabsirin marks a morally unstable cognitive capacity rather than saving knowledge: perception is available but does not govern allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Inward discernment supplies the capacity whose failure must be explained without simply deleting it.
Manifest proofs immediately repeat the focus's clarity and rule out a merely hidden message.
Pride supplies a motivational force capable of overriding acknowledged evidence.
Denial performed with knowledge supplies the clearest contextual model for lucid refusal.
Overt speech carries the correct creator-answer, showing that the missing element is not the proposition itself.
Reversal from a proper orientation supplies the directional failure after correct acknowledgment.
Reason as a restraint from ignorance exposes the practical restraint that most fail to exercise.

structural_cues: 29:39 immediately follows the focus with clear proofs followed by arrogance.
29:61 and 29:63 repeat a question, the correct answer 'God,' and then language of inversion or failed reasoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clarity, knowledgeable denial, correct answers, pride, and reversal; I infer a split between propositional recognition and governing commitment. The alternative remains that mustabsirin is ironic or reflexive—people who only considered themselves perceptive.

changed_reading.before: Mustabsirin either excuses them as genuinely guided or must be weakened to 'they thought they knew.'
changed_reading.after: The verse can sustain genuine cognitive access alongside pride-driven denial and practical disorientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby weaver-house analogy lets deeds be read cumulatively. Repeated intentional acts are threads that construct a habitat of dependency; its attractiveness and felt shelter conceal structural weakness, and the self-built environment then helps bar exit from the route.

activation_trace.role: Purposive deeds supply the repeatable units that can accumulate into a lived structure.
Displayed attractiveness explains why a fragile structure is experienced as desirable shelter.
Habitation anchors the analogy back in the focus's own settled space.
Protective attachment and alliance supply the social dependencies for which the house stands.
The weaving creature supplies the image of a shelter produced from its maker's own repeated activity.
A home as refuge supplies the apparent protective function of the constructed network.
Loss of strength reveals that the attractive refuge cannot bear the reliance placed upon it.

structural_cues: 29:41 repeats taking patrons, the spider taking a house, and house language three times.
The focus uniquely places dwellings, adorned deeds, and path-obstruction in one clause chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a self-produced woven house, reliance, and weakness; I infer that the focus's adorned deeds can likewise accrete into a trapping habitat. The stated analogy may instead concern patrons only, without identifying deeds as threads.

changed_reading.before: Each adorned deed is an isolated bad choice made inside an otherwise neutral dwelling.
changed_reading.after: Adorned deeds weave a whole habitat of reliance whose apparent shelter makes departure from the way increasingly difficult.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies a counter-obstruction: established prayer restrains indecency, and remembrance repeatedly restores salience while God knows what people produce. Bare insight failed in the focus; an embodied, recurrent practice can interrupt the conversion of attractive valuation into action.

activation_trace.role: The focus's harmful diversion supplies one side of the opposed blocking functions.
Available insight exposes the need for a mechanism that carries perception into restraint.
The specified worship supplies the embodied and repeatable practice that can intervene before action.
The alternate mapped branch emphasizes worship as binding, reinforcing continuity rather than a momentary insight.
Active restraint supplies the protective block that opposes being diverted from the route.
Retrieval after forgetfulness supplies recurrent restoration of what adornment has made less salient.
Making and producing reconnects the prescription to the focus's concern with enacted works.

structural_cues: 29:45 sequences recitation, establishment, restraint, remembrance, and divine knowledge of production.
The restraining predicate in 29:45 reverses the focus's predicate of being diverted.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies prayer's preventive relation and remembrance; I infer that this is a process-level answer to the focus's sight-action gap. It may alternatively be a general instruction rather than a direct antidote to the historical mechanism in 29:38.

changed_reading.before: Once people understand the way, better information should be sufficient to keep them on it.
changed_reading.after: Discernment requires a recurrent embodied brake; remembered practice can block the very actions that attractive valuation would release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context shifts the sensory register across time. Works first appear attractive to sight; consequence then arrives without fine awareness, envelops from above and below, and is tasted as what was done. The action's beautified surface is reversed into an inescapable embodied experience.

activation_trace.role: Presented beauty supplies the initial visual and evaluative register of the deeds.
Seeing intensifies the paradox that another kind of sensing still fails.
Sudden arrival supplies the temporal break between attractive action and recognized consequence.
Fine-grained awareness marks the sensitivity they lack despite the focus's broader claim of sight.
An all-enveloping cover turns consequence into a surrounding environment.
The alternate mapped covering branch reinforces total sensory occlusion.
Experiential testing supplies the later bodily knowledge that visual appraisal did not deliver.
Purposive doing explicitly identifies the tasted outcome with their own prior practice.

structural_cues: 29:53 joins sudden arrival to lack of awareness; 29:55 changes from encompassing punishment to 'taste what you were doing.'
The focus's visual vocabulary and 29:55's gustatory imperative create a sensory reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies suddenness, failed awareness, envelopment, tasting, and prior work; I infer that deeds generate the later sensorium in which their value is learned. The alternative is the looser legal reading that punishment merely recompenses, rather than becomes the experience of, the deeds.

changed_reading.before: Their deeds look good now and receive an externally added punishment later.
changed_reading.after: The beautified deeds return as an enveloping, tasted consequence whose real value is learned bodily and too late.

context_deltas.mechanism: Diversion occupies a person with one thing instead of another, while play can be skilled action without a sound end. Applied to the focus, adornment does not need to corrupt factual sight or technical competence; it can substitute ends, making purposive work serve a route-defeating purpose.

activation_trace.role: Intentional action supplies competence and purpose as the layer whose ultimate end can be captured.
A traversable route supplies the larger end against which locally successful actions are measured.
Inner acuity can remain intact at the level of means even when the final end is displaced.
Occupation by one thing away from another supplies salience displacement rather than ignorance.
Action lacking a sound objective supplies the model of competent activity with a failed telos.
Disclosure to the knower echoes the focus's sight-language while leaving the problem of governing ends unresolved.

structural_cues: 29:64 contrasts diversion and play with enduring life, then closes with a counterfactual of knowing.
The focus places intentional works between beautification and loss of the route.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies functional images of diversion and aimless action plus the focus's work-route sequence; I infer that adornment captures ends and salience. The live alternative is that 29:64 classifies worldly life generally without specifying the psychology of 'Ad and Thamud.

changed_reading.before: Their mistake was holding false beliefs about what they were doing.
changed_reading.after: They may see facts and execute means well while their attractive activity is severed from the end that would make it a true path.

context_deltas.mechanism: Instability strips mixed allegiance away, but arrival on firm land restores association; protected sanctuary likewise coexists with trust in falsehood while danger surrounds it. Security and settled repose can thus be enabling conditions for the focus's ornamental misvaluation, whereas crisis briefly clarifies dependence.

activation_trace.role: Repose and felt familiarity anchor the proposed relapse mechanism in the focus dwellings.
Attractive presentation supplies the evaluative layer that ordinary security has room to rebuild.
Purification after mixture supplies the crisis-induced clearing of divided allegiance.
Dry land supplies the restored stable environment at which the behavioral reversal occurs.
Renewed association marks relapse as soon as safety returns.
The paired occurrence binds felt safety and heart-trust in one verse, exposing their perverse uncoupling.
A protected spatial precinct supplies concrete, socially maintained security.
Rapid seizure outside the protected zone supplies the danger against which complacent safety is contrasted.

structural_cues: 29:65 has an explicit sea-danger, rescue, land, and immediate relapse sequence.
29:67 contrasts a safe precinct with people being seized around it and then contrasts false trust with rejected favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies environment-linked reversals; I infer that security enables ornamental self-deception and crisis temporarily clears it. The alternative is a purely evidentiary charge of ingratitude, with no causal role assigned to settled safety itself.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings are neutral scenery and misdirection is constant across circumstances.
changed_reading.after: Settled safety can be the medium in which attractive false valuation regrows, while exposed danger briefly restores undivided perception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence makes guidance processual: strenuous exertion is followed by gentle direction into paths. This reverses the focus's static paradox. Possessing sight is not yet movement; committed exertion becomes the condition under which direction is supplied and a barred route becomes traversable.

activation_trace.role: Insight without movement supplies the inadequate initial condition that the closing process revises.
Diversion supplies the obstructed state reversed at the close.
Expenditure of capacity under difficulty supplies committed motion rather than passive recognition.
Gentle indication toward route and truth supplies responsive direction after exertion.
Traversable paths provide the opened counterpart to the focus's barred way.

structural_cues: 29:69 explicitly orders striving before promised guidance.
The focus's singular barred way is answered by plural guided paths at the close, though the number contrast need not imply unrelated destinations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the striving-to-guidance sequence and repeated route root; I infer a direct reversal of the focus's sight without motion. The alternative is that the closing promise concerns a different group and the singular-plural contrast is stylistic rather than mechanistic.

changed_reading.before: Correct sight should itself place a person on the way.
changed_reading.after: Sight is only potential orientation; costly exertion and received guidance convert it into actual passage along opened paths.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus word is a proper name, and its non-dominant mapped counting root must never replace the name in translation. It remains worth carrying because the packet explicitly preserves that split target, the focus opens as an elliptical list, and the context surrounds the list with counting and case-by-case taking. Render only as a compositional or acoustic shadow: a moral archive whose entries are counted, not as the lexical meaning of 'Ad.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening name 'Ad is the focus occurrence mapped both to the proper-name/return inventory and to a non-dominant counting inventory.

activation_trace.role: Enumeration in the non-dominant target makes the opening name-list faintly resemble a counted register.
Counting and reckoning establish an early register against which untested assumptions are measured.
The explicit thousand supplies unusually exact chronological enumeration in the historical archive.
The unit of five supports the precision of the stated subtraction rather than a vague long duration.
Comprehensive totality frames the subsequent destroyed groups as exhaustively handled cases.
Each case's own offense supplies the item against which its consequence is matched.

changed_reading.before: The initial names are simply two more peoples appended to a narrative list.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory sound-pattern, the names enter a counted case archive in which each civilization is registered with its own deed and consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The hydraulic model is cross-domain and should not be presented as the verse's lexical paraphrase. It remains anchored because the focus obstruction inventory includes a route to water, the way is explicitly a traversable channel, and later water makes dead earth live while rivers cut through land. Downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy: polished settled works may interrupt a life-bearing flow and leave only still dwellings.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins a blocked route to dwellings whose root also carries cessation of motion.

activation_trace.role: A route leading toward water supplies the literal hydraulic image within the focus obstruction root.
An extended channel of passage lets moral route and material flow remain in controlled analogy.
Cessation of movement supplies the stagnant endpoint of a blocked life-bearing flow.
A river cutting land with running water supplies the positive image of sustained passage.
Water delivered by pouring or irrigation supplies the regenerative medium that must reach its recipient.
Land revived through rain states the life-producing consequence of restored flow.

changed_reading.before: Blocking the way is only an abstract change of religious opinion.
changed_reading.after: As a contained ecological analogy, misdirection is a blocked life-channel: attractive fixed works arrest regenerative flow until inhabited space becomes still residue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because mustabsirin is most naturally cognitive, whereas the defensive-equipment branch belongs to a related nominal image. It remains visibly anchored to the focus root and is sharpened by the weak-house and protected-sanctuary contrasts. It should appear only as a secondary martial shadow—'as though equipped with a shield'—never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Mustabsirin closes the focus verse, and its branch inventory includes protective equipment alongside inward sight.

activation_trace.role: Protective equipment gives perception an exploratory defensive shadow: insight treated as something one can feel armed by.
Shelter supplies the external defensive analogue to confidence in one's own perceptive equipment.
Structural weakness exposes the failure of apparent protection.
A spatially protected precinct supplies the strongest contextual image of being externally secured.
Rapid seizure outside the protected space shows the limit and contingency of material defense.

changed_reading.before: Their perceptiveness is purely an intellectual asset that inexplicably fails to help.
changed_reading.after: In a cautious secondary image, they are insight-armored and settlement-protected, yet their chosen defenses cannot protect orientation or outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The severe-breaking image comes from the non-dominant mapped target of the context guidance root, so it is form-distant and must not redefine the guidance verb. It remains valuable because the packet preserves the split mapping and 29:69 directly reverses the focus's barrier-and-path configuration. Qualify it as an imagistic undertone: divine direction may be experienced as path-clearing that breaks an obstruction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus has a barrier-like obstruction from the way; the final verse repeats the way root in a promise of guidance.

activation_trace.role: A massive barrier gives the focus's diversion a resistant spatial body.
The route supplies what lies inaccessible behind the obstruction.
Effort under difficulty supplies the forceful human side of passage through resistance.
Gentle direction preserves the actual semantic center of the promised guidance.
The non-dominant severe-breaking image supplies the exploratory undertone of demolishing what blocks the route.
The returned path root completes the movement from obstruction to opened passage.

changed_reading.before: Guidance at the close merely supplies information about an already open road.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root image, guidance also clears passage by breaking the very barrier that left perceptive people stationary.

strongest_changes: Mustabsirin became a diagnosis of lucid but non-governing perception: pride, salience, and ends can redirect action without deleting knowledge.
The dwellings became active residual evidence and, through the house analogy, a self-produced habitat of fragile reliance rather than neutral scenery.
Path obstruction became socially mediated through recruitment, false liability transfer, public normalization, and control of passage.
The closing striving-to-guidance sequence answered static sight with costly movement and received direction along opened paths.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses two opposed acts of seeing—clarity for later viewers and perceptiveness among former residents—around dwellings, adorned intentional work, and a barred route. Context activated this compression as an evidence ecology, a social path-system, a teleological failure, and several controlled material shadows without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Mustabsirin may assert genuine insight, ironic self-estimation, or a mixture of visual and inward acuity; the packet does not force one choice.
The return/counting resonances around the proper name 'Ad and the demolition shadow in the split guidance root are heuristic activations, not secure lexical claims.
The extent to which settled security causes misdirection, rather than merely displays ingratitude after it, remains materially open.
